# v0.8 measured evidence

Local Cancun EVM, complete signed VM.runTx transactions, depth-32 production relations with development Groth16 keys. No external audit, public deployment, production ceremony, or mobile/browser measurements.

Gas includes transaction intrinsic cost and applies transaction refunds. Execution gas is also retained in the JSON. Values below come from the ordered lifecycle workload, with cold accesses reset for each transaction. They are not ring-wrap steady-state measurements. Calldata is randomized, so reruns can differ slightly.

| Operation | Native execution | Native total | Hashed execution | Hashed total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| First token deposit | 189,335 | 213,303 | 189,335 | 213,279 |
| 20 deposits, per item | 44,534 | 48,777 | 44,534 | 48,775 |
| Insert 16 entries | 264,963 | 292,551 | 264,963 | 292,539 |
| Queued transfer | 426,716 | 471,640 | 341,499 | 386,411 |
| Batch, per included transfer | 210,871 | 239,535 | 194,529 | 223,191 |
| Direct token spend | 548,981 | 588,841 | 416,747 | 456,607 |
| Token withdrawal + change | 444,944 | 490,132 | 359,727 | 404,915 |
| Two-note token exit | 408,392 | 436,900 | 354,506 | 383,014 |
| ETH exit | 381,309 | 405,053 | 327,423 | 351,143 |
| Eight-input consolidation | 603,303 | 651,335 | 471,066 | 519,050 |

The aggregate transaction includes 14 transfers and skips two stale submissions. Its per-transfer figure includes the stale calldata and tip-credit work. Each transfer enables one input and retains a second dummy nullifier. The single transfer and batch execute at different points in the same lifecycle, so their difference is not a controlled estimate of verification savings alone.
